scripts.check: for f in 'untangler@bluvulture'/*.js; do node --check "$f" || exit 1; done
scripts.verify: npm test && npm run check && glib-compile-schemas --strict --dry-run 'untangler@bluvulture/schemas/' && bash -n scripts/install.sh scripts/package.sh scripts/verify-package.sh && node -e "JSON.parse(require('fs').readFileSync('untangler@bluvulture/metadata.json','utf8'))" && bash scripts/verify-package.sh
